chunks: And Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:
Taqiyyah is in every necessity, and the one concerned knows best about it when it befalls him.

key_terms.أَعْلَمُ: More knowing; best able to judge the reality of the circumstance
key_terms.التَّقِيَّةُ: Taqiyyah; protective dissimulation practiced in circumstances of danger or necessity
key_terms.تَنْزِلُ: Befalls; comes upon or occurs to a person
key_terms.صَاحِبُهَا: Its possessor; the person directly experiencing the situation
key_terms.ضَرُورَةٍ: Necessity; a constraining situation that compels exception

ai.seo_question: When is taqiyyah allowed according to Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that taqiyyah applies in situations of necessity. It also indicates that the person facing the circumstance is the most aware of when that necessity truly applies to him.
